objective: Compare the pre-speed baseline and merged speed treatment with independently authored, quality-gated, eight-slide full PPT pipelines on the same source and fixed confirmation.

historical_run_policy.reason: The prior treatment was generated in the accumulated interactive context with cache_condition=uncontrolled.

control.description: round-5 baseline before the merged speed program

schedule.design: ABBA, serial, two independent process-cold runs per arm

cold_scope.memory: memories.use_memories=false and prompt forbids memory access
cold_scope.artifacts: new detached worktree, new project, no prior spec/SVG/PPTX reuse
cold_scope.process: new node/codex process and isolated CODEX_SQLITE_HOME per run
cold_scope.required_label: agent-context/artifact/process cold; OS and provider cache uncontrolled

runner.sandbox: disabled for the isolated benchmark process after repository execpolicy blocked even read-only prechecks

observer.external_process_wall_clock_scope: node/codex process start through process exit, including owner load, project init, authoring, export, verification, diagnostics, and requested preview shutdown
observer.telemetry_scope: project init complete through telemetry end

user_experience_primary.name: full_process_wall_clock_ms
user_experience_primary.summary: arm median and two paired improvements

low_variance_coprimary.name: executor_initial_input_bytes
low_variance_coprimary.includes: initial planning representation plus immediate mandatory spec_lock read plus required Executor references

secondary: gate and tool-call counts when observable

pre_first_valid_run_amendment.reason: The initial slot-1 launch stopped before owner loading or project creation because repository execpolicy blocked all shell prechecks under approval=never. A read-only probe confirmed that --ignore-rules alone was insufficient and that the CLI bypass flag was required for non-interactive execution.
pre_first_valid_run_amendment.timing: This amendment occurred before any valid pipeline run.

decision_rule.retain_treatment: All quality guards pass; treatment initial Executor bytes improve by at least 30% in both treatment runs; and treatment median full-process wall clock is no more than 5% slower.
decision_rule.directional_speed_go: Retain criteria pass and treatment median wall clock improves by at least 10%, with both paired wall-clock improvements positive.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Quality passes but wall-clock direction is mixed or treatment median lies between 5% regression and 10% improvement.
decision_rule.reject_or_rework: Any treatment quality failure, deterministic-byte MCID failure, or treatment median wall clock regression greater than 5%.
decision_rule.n2_limit: No claim of population-level statistical superiority or generalization to other deck families.
